# Pest Off East Midlands

> Professional, BPCA-certified pest control contractor serving Nottingham and the East Midlands. Established in 2017. Domestic home pest eradication and commercial compliance contracts.

## Key Business Information
- **Business Name**: Pest Off East Midlands
- **Telephone / Emergency Callouts**: 07401 555142 (+44 7401 555142)
- **Email**: info@pestoffeastmidlands.co.uk
- **Office Location**: City Gate East, Tollhouse Hill, Nottingham, NG1 5FS, United Kingdom
- **Operating Hours**: All hours, 7 days a week (Emergency callouts available)
- **Accreditations**: British Pest Control Association (BPCA) Registered, RSPH Level 2 Certified Technicians, SafeContractor approved
- **Key Features**: Child & pet safe tamper-resistant bait stations, discreet unmarked vans, guaranteed results, audit-ready commercial logbooks

## Core Services
- **Residential Pest Eradication**: Fast, dependable treatment of rodents (rats, mice, squirrels), wasps, hornets, bed bugs, fleas, ants, and cockroaches for homeowners, tenants, and landlords.
- **Commercial Pest Control Contracts**: Proactive, scheduled preventative inspections, full HACCP and Environmental Health Officer (EHO) compliance documentation, and emergency support for hospitality, healthcare, logistics, and retail.
- **Bird Proofing & Solar Panel Protection**: Deterrents, netting, and spikes for pigeon and gull prevention.
- **Wasp Nest Removal**: Rapid same-day and emergency treatments with guaranteed nest elimination.

## Regional Coverage (Nottingham & East Midlands)
Primary hubs and coverage areas:
- Nottingham City Centre (NG1, NG2)

- Beeston & Chilwell (NG9)
- Wollaton (NG8)
- Arnold (NG5)
- Hucknall (NG15)
- Bingham & Rushcliffe (NG13)
- Edwalton & Compton Acres (NG12, NG2)
- Carlton, Mapperley, Sherwood, Bulwell, Ruddington, Long Eaton, and Stapleford.
Technicians cover all surrounding towns and villages across Nottinghamshire and Derbyshire.
